content_sections.heading: TNUAVC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria & Qualification
content_sections.text: Eligibility requirements vary significantly by post, ranging from 10th pass to a relevant Bachelor's degree, along with post-specific certifications and experience. Educational qualification and experience requirements vary post to post; candidates are advised to check the official TNUAVC notification carefully before applying.

rows.qualification_experience: Valid DGCA-approved Remote Pilot Certificate (RPC). Experience operating multirotor and fixed-wing drones preferred. Knowledge of drone mapping software, flight planning applications, maintenance and troubleshooting is an added advantage.

Certification in drone operations or a relevant technical qualification preferred. Basic knowledge of drone systems and field operations required. Freshers with a strong interest in drone technology may also apply.
Valid LMV Driving License with a good driving record. Knowledge of routes, highways, traffic regulations, and basic vehicle maintenance preferred.
Prior experience in kitchen/catering assistance preferred. Basic hygiene and cleanliness knowledge required; must be physically fit for kitchen-related work.

Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Administration, Commerce, or any recognized discipline. Preferably 2–5 years of experience in tender management, procurement, Government/PSU/e-Procurement tenders, and bid documentation.
DGCA-certified Drone Pilot with 1+ years of experience in drone piloting or training. Strong technical knowledge of UAV operations required.
Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in a relevant field. Experience in control room operations, monitoring, or supervision preferred, with good communication and coordination skills.
Experience cooking for offices, hostels, institutions, or catering services preferred. Knowledge of South Indian and North Indian cooking, hygiene, and kitchen management desirable.
Prior experience in housekeeping or office maintenance preferred. Knowledge of cleaning methods and hygiene practices required.

Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Science, Management, or any recognized discipline (Aerospace/Aviation/Electronics/Mechanical background preferred). Should have completed a DGCA-recognized Remote Pilot Instructor course or be familiar with RPTO procedures, with knowledge of DGCA Civil Aviation Requirements (CAR). Around 2–3 years of experience in the aviation/drone industry or a similar supervisory role is preferred.

faq.question: Q1. What is TNUAVC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by the Tamil Nadu Unmanned Aerial Vehicles Corporation (TNUAVC) to fill 36 posts, including Drone Pilot, Drone Co-Pilot, RPTO Instructor, RPTO Supervisor, Supervisor, Tender Executive, Car Driver, Cook, Cook Helper, and House Keeping, all based in Chennai.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in TNUAVC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 36 vacancies are notified: Drone Pilot (7), Drone Co-Pilot (7), RPTO Instructor (7), RPTO Supervisor (8), Supervisor (2), Car Driver (1), Cook Helper (1), Tender Executive (1), Cook (1), and House Keeping (1).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for TNUAVC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 18 September 2026, by 5:00 PM, either by post/in person or by email.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for TNUAVC Drone Pilot posts?
faq.answer: A valid DGCA-approved Remote Pilot Certificate (RPC) is required, with experience in operating multirotor and fixed-wing drones preferred. Full post-wise qualification details for all 10 posts are listed in the Eligibility section above.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for TNUAVC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline - either by post/in person to the Managing Director's office in Guindy, Chennai, or by emailing the scanned, completed application to [email protected] or [email protected] - on or before 18 September 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for TNUAVC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on Short Listing of applications followed by an Interview; no written exam is mentioned.
